The [[Gambler/Legends|gambler]] [[Zarro Flynn]] organized an invite-only [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] '''tournament''' on<ref name="Mission" /> the [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]]<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]<ref name="Mission" /> by [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Date">Per the reasoning [[Template:TOR_dates|here]], Act I of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' takes place around [[3643 BBY]]. Since players of ''The Old Republic'' can assign their companions on the mission "Into the Sabacc Pit" independently of the main class storyline at any point during the [[Star Wars video games|game]], the mission must take place at some point around 3643 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="Mission" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
Around that [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="Date" /> an individual associated with one of the two opposing governments in the Cold War sent a companion of theirs to Flynn's tournament, despite it being an invitation-only event, with the intention of seeking [[Black market/Legends|black market]] opportunities. One of the tournament's participants, a [[Unidentified Zeltron gambler|Zeltron gambler]], put up some rare possessions as collateral on a loan and then proceeded to lose, which was beneficial for the companion.<ref name="Mission" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Zarro Flynn's sabacc tournament was mentioned in [[BioWare]]'s [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' within the Crew Skill Mission "Into the Sabacc Pit", though the information regarding the mission's outcome was later removed from the [[Star Wars video games|video game]].<ref name="Mission" />
